notes.bora: Never changes its form: bora kuliko (better than).

guidebook.intro: Swahili adjectives have no “-er” or “-est”. You compare with kuliko (than), zaidi (more) and kuliko wote (of all).

tips.title: Bigger, biggest
body: Keep the adjective as it is and add **kuliko** (than): **mkubwa kuliko simba** (bigger than the lion). With no comparison named, add **zaidi**: **mrefu zaidi** (taller).
For “the most”, say **kuliko wote** (than all), agreeing with the noun when needed: **mlima mrefu kuliko yote** (the highest mountain of all).

culture.title: Afya ni bora kuliko mali
body: “Health is better than wealth” is said to the sick, to the overworked and to anyone chasing money too hard. It’s one of the first proverbs children learn.
